svg.title: Darb Lab
svg.desc: Darb Lab is where I build with the stacks Darb doesn't use: Java and Spring, C# and .NET, Python and machine learning. Each one is a product of its own, and they all share one world. Every Lab project sends its real events into Darb Budokai, an RPG powered by my real life.
